title: Quality Measure Endorsement (QME)
content: Quality Measure Endorsement Print Minus Related Pages Quality measures provide a way to quantify the performance of facilities through a consistent and accountable approach. Measures that are endorsed by a consensus-based entity (CBE) are considered the gold standard for quality measurement. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s (CDC) National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) tracks healthcare-associated infections and other patient safety-related metrics utilizing endorsed quality measures. CDC NHSN is the steward and/or developer of the following evidenced based measures. For further details regarding the following CDC NHSN endorsed quality measures please visit the CBE measure database .
